content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-498. - I.P.M.C. Section 303.1, Swimming pools.
content.summary:
Section 302.10. Swimming pools,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
302.10. Swimming pools.
Swimming pools shall be maintained in a clean, safe and sanitary condition."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
